in_marathi.name: Devadatt
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devadatt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Devadatt' is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘datt’ meaning ‘given’ or ‘son’. This name is believed to be given to a child who is considered to be a god's son.
